plot_scene: plot a PyTorch3D scene with Meshes, Pointclouds, Cameras, and RayBundle objects into named Plotly subplots
plot_batch_individually: plot each element of a batched Meshes, Pointclouds, or Cameras object into its own Plotly subplot
get_camera_wireframe: generate a 3D wireframe tensor representing a camera symbol for visualization in Plotly
Lighting: configure ambient, diffuse, specular, fresnel, and roughness lighting parameters for Mesh3D rendering in Plotly
AxisArgs: configure Plotly 3D scene axis display options like grid, ticks, labels, and background color
